_note: Seed for the authority table (CLAUDE.md §5, §6.4). Year only; no pinpoint citations or exact dates. Every entry is unverified until a human checks it against the judgment (build step J). Propositions restate CLAUDE.md §5.

authorities.title: Innoventive Industries Ltd. v. ICICI Bank
authorities.proposition: On proof of financial debt and default, a complete s.7 application is to be admitted.

authorities.title: Mobilox Innovations Pvt. Ltd. v. Kirusa Software Pvt. Ltd.
authorities.proposition: A s.9 application is to be rejected if a plausible, pre-existing dispute exists; the tribunal does not examine the merits beyond seeing that the defence is not spurious or illusory.

authorities.title: B.K. Educational Services Pvt. Ltd. v. Parag Gupta and Associates
authorities.proposition: Article 137 of the Limitation Act applies to s.7 and s.9 applications; three years from the date of default.

authorities.title: ArcelorMittal India Pvt. Ltd. v. Satish Kumar Gupta
authorities.proposition: Eligibility of resolution applicants under s.29A.

authorities.title: State Bank of India v. V. Ramakrishnan
authorities.proposition: The s.14 moratorium does not protect personal guarantors.

authorities.title: Swiss Ribbons Pvt. Ltd. v. Union of India
authorities.proposition: Constitutional validity of the Code; distinction between financial and operational creditors.

authorities.title: Pioneer Urban Land and Infrastructure Ltd. v. Union of India
authorities.proposition: Homebuyers are financial creditors.

authorities.title: K. Sashidhar v. Indian Overseas Bank
authorities.proposition: The commercial wisdom of the CoC is non-justiciable; review is limited to s.30(2) compliance.

authorities.title: Committee of Creditors of Essar Steel India Ltd. v. Satish Kumar Gupta
authorities.proposition: CoC commercial wisdom is non-justiciable; the s.12 outer limit is ordinarily binding but extendable in exceptional cases.

authorities.title: Embassy Property Developments Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Karnataka
authorities.proposition: Public-law decisions are outside the NCLT's s.60(5) jurisdiction.

authorities.title: Anuj Jain, Interim Resolution Professional for Jaypee Infratech Ltd. v. Axis Bank Ltd.
authorities.proposition: Preferential transactions; related-party mortgages.

authorities.title: Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Ltd. v. Amit Gupta
authorities.proposition: s.60(5)(c) residuary jurisdiction is confined to disputes arising solely from or relating to the insolvency.

authorities.title: Ghanashyam Mishra and Sons Pvt. Ltd. v. Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Co. Ltd.
authorities.proposition: An approved resolution plan binds all; claims not included are extinguished.

authorities.title: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd. v. Bishal Jaiswal
authorities.proposition: Balance sheet entries can amount to an acknowledgment of liability; whether a given entry does is a question of fact.

authorities.title: Sesh Nath Singh v. Baidyabati Sheoraphuli Co-operative Bank Ltd.
authorities.proposition: s.14 exclusion and s.5 condonation apply to s.7 applications.

authorities.title: Orator Marketing Pvt. Ltd. v. Samtex Desinz Pvt. Ltd.
authorities.proposition: An interest-free term loan can be a financial debt.

authorities.title: Phoenix ARC Pvt. Ltd. v. Spade Financial Services Ltd.
authorities.proposition: Related-party exclusion from the CoC.

authorities.title: P. Mohanraj v. Shah Brothers Ispat Pvt. Ltd.
authorities.proposition: s.138 NI Act proceedings and the moratorium.

authorities.title: Lalit Kumar Jain v. Union of India
authorities.proposition: Personal guarantor notification upheld.

authorities.title: Manish Kumar v. Union of India
authorities.proposition: Class-creditor thresholds in the s.7 provisos upheld.

authorities.title: V. Nagarajan v. SKS Ispat and Power Ltd.
authorities.proposition: s.61 limitation runs from pronouncement where the party is present or aware, not from receipt of the certified copy.

authorities.title: Dena Bank v. C. Shivakumar Reddy
authorities.proposition: A recovery certificate or decree can give a fresh cause of action (scope to be verified).

authorities.title: Laxmi Pat Surana v. Union Bank of India
authorities.proposition: Guarantor default and acknowledgment interplay (scope to be verified).

authorities.title: Vidarbha Industries Power Ltd. v. Axis Bank Ltd.
authorities.proposition: Read 'may' in s.7(5)(a) as discretionary; later confined to its own facts.

authorities.title: State Tax Officer v. Rainbow Papers Ltd.
authorities.proposition: Statutory dues treated as secured; contested, track subsequent treatment.

authorities.title: M. Suresh Kumar Reddy v. Canara Bank
authorities.proposition: Vidarbha confined to its own facts; no general discretion to refuse admission.

authorities.title: Dilip B. Jiwrajka v. Union of India
authorities.proposition: Procedure under Part III, ss.95-100.
